title: Answer key for one sample release
description: Lists the gaps seeded in a sample release so eval/score.py can score the analyzer's findings.json. One key per release and dated snapshot. Findings are matched to key entries by plan item and gap type.

snapshot.description: The Jira snapshot date this key describes.

author.description: Who wrote the sample data (not the tool author).

plan_files.description: The plan files the reader is given, in order.

gaps.description: Every seeded gap the analyzer should report for this snapshot. Hidden (weak) ones included; mark them with expected_strength: weak.

plan_item_id.description: The plan item id Stage A gives it (p3). Used first for matching.

plan_quote_contains.description: A distinctive phrase from the plan item's source quote. Used when ids differ between runs.

ticket.description: The ticket the finding should cite, or null for none found.

why.description: One sentence: what was seeded and where (which comment, which due date).

linkage_gaps.description: Tickets in other teams' projects that are related but not linked to the epic. At least one must be a blocker (PRD R12).

blocker.description: True for the unlinked cross-team blocker that must be surfaced in every run.

noise.description: Tickets that look related but are not. A finding that cites one of these is a false positive.

status_changes.description: What changed between the previous snapshot and this one, and the effect on findings.

expected_effect.description: e.g. 'the SRE cross_team_date finding appears' or 'no change to findings'.
